## dipavli ke shubh avsar par nrity evan sangit ka sundar aayojan
Dipavli ke pavan evan mangalmay avsar par amit karmakar evan unke sabhi sathiyon ki or se aap sabhi ko hardik shubhkamnaen evan badhaee.
Dipavli keval dipon ka tyohar nahin, balki khushiyon, umang, prem, ekta aur naee ummidon ka pratik hai. is shubh avsar ko aur bhi yadgar banane ke lie amit karmakar evan unke sathi nrity aur sangit ke madhyam se khushiyon ke rang bikherne ja rahe hain.
